tools.name: vertodigital_get_site_index
tools.description: Lists every page on vertodigital.com as a markdown index: one link and a one-line summary per page, grouped under section headings such as Services, Industries, Case studies, Content Hub and Agent API. Use it to discover what exists and to find slugs: each link has the form https://vertodigital.com/

tools.name: vertodigital_get_page
tools.description: Fetches one vertodigital.com page as clean markdown, with navigation, footer and scripts left out: service pages, case studies, blog posts, ebooks, event recaps, legal pages and more. Use it once you know which page you want; find slugs with vertodigital_get_site_index, or take the case-studies/<slu

tools.name: vertodigital_search_case_studies
tools.description: Searches VertoDigital's full case-study library (B2B technology clients in cybersecurity, data platforms, FinTech, GTM SaaS, cloud infrastructure and more) and returns the matching lines as markdown, with section headings kept for context. Each match carries a case-studies/<slug> link to pass to ver

tools.name: vertodigital_get_contact
tools.description: Returns who to contact at VertoDigital and how: the named growth lead, their email and LinkedIn, the reply-time commitment and the contact-form URL. Use it when a user asks how to reach the team or who to talk to. To send a message on the user's behalf, use vertodigital_send_enquiry instead; for any

tools.name: vertodigital_get_value_proposition
tools.description: Matches a buyer's challenge to VertoDigital's offer and returns up to three structured lists: services (which service fits, how it works, and a headline client result), proof_points (flagship case studies with headline stats and links) and differentiators (reasons clients choose VertoDigital, each b

tools.name: vertodigital_send_enquiry
tools.description: Sends a message from a user to the VertoDigital team, delivered to the team's CRM and inbox, and returns a reference ID; the team replies to fromEmail, normally within one business day. Use it for service questions, partnerships, press, careers, and to request the free Pipeline Readiness Assessment

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact · Private data: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Destructive: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact · Private data: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Destructive: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vertodigital_get_site_index" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
